prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: DFU NPC pixel-art eye atlas
Primary request: Refine the supplied 3x3 reference atlas into nine natural, clearly distinct gaze directions for this same woman. Keep her afraid/worried expression in every cell, with her lifted, tense worried brows intact. Each cell is the complete upper face, 64:35 aspect, with identical framing. Return only one 3x3 atlas.
Input image: Image 1 is the sole reference. It is the exact inspected 3x3 grid made from this portrait's own afraid open-eye source.
Direction order: top-left=up-left, top-center=up, top-right=up-right; middle-left=left, middle-center=center, middle-right=right; bottom-left=down-left, bottom-center=down, bottom-right=down-right. Both eyes point together. Diagonal cells must visibly combine horizontal and vertical gaze; do not repeat left, center, or right.
Bounded visual correction: Make each iris read as a compact rounded or curved shape, using small stepped pixel edges, especially in all three top-row up-gaze cells. Do not use a flat purple bar or equal-width rectangular purple block. Give the iris a slightly narrower top and bottom with a subtly wider middle, and keep a small dark pupil clearly inside it. Do not enlarge the iris.
Eye anatomy: Keep pupils and irises inside both eye openings in every cell. For upward gaze, naturally raise the upper lids enough to make room for the higher irises; do not push iris through a fixed slit. Maintain smooth continuous upper and lower lid contours in both eyes for all nine poses, with preserved corners and spacing. For downward gaze, lower gaze under a naturally lowered upper lid and let the lid cover part of the iris as needed. Both pupils must remain visible. Do not move brows or whole sockets to fake gaze.
Highlights: Keep exactly tiny, low-contrast warm muted highlights. Avoid glaring white or pale specular pinpricks, especially in the picture-right eye. Do not remove highlights entirely; balance both eyes.
Identity and expression: Preserve this exact face, hair, skin, pixel lattice, palette, crop and fearful/worried brow tension. Do not neutralize brows or turn the expression sad. Middle-center should match the supplied afraid source. Keep everything outside eye features unchanged.
Style and constraints: Low-resolution softly shaded pixel art. Retain compact muted violet-gray irises, small dark pupils, tiny restrained warm highlights, warm subdued sclera and original brown skin/hair palette. Keep original square pixels. No vector-round eyes, giant irises, huge white areas, bright sparkle, labels, borders, gutters, text, or extra content.
